agentDirectory.note: No agents are live yet in any roster. Counts reflect proposals across three unreconciled documents, not a running system.

nigerianSme.content: Techzoid Innovation, Brela Agency, Huxxle, and Responsive AI Agency offer WhatsApp chatbots, CRM pipelines, and workflow automation for Nigerian SMEs. None publish public pricing; engagements appear quote-based. Huxxle is the most productized, bundling inventory, CRM, invoicing, and storefronts.

generalAiConsulting.content: Cieden ($50-99/hr), RTS Labs ($5,000-50,000 per engagement), and MQLFlow (packages from £2,900) serve SMB/mid-market clients with AI readiness audits, workflow automation, and agent systems. Pricing is mostly project-based or hourly rather than fixed packages.
